meta.title: Evaluator rejects a re-evaluation request; ranks stay unchanged

steps.note: Open an existing event whose technical evaluation is ready for the evaluator.
Open the Technical Stage where the pending re-evaluation request is shown.

args.goal: as the Technical Evaluator, open the pending re-evaluation request, choose Reject, enter a rejection reason in the line-item dialog, click Reject Re-evaluation, and stop when the screen proves the line items are TR Submitted with their original technical rankings unchanged

steps.note: No catalog domain step handles rejecting a re-evaluation request, so perform the complete buyer-side evaluator workflow and require the final status and ranking evidence on screen.
Explicitly assert the required post-rejection status.
